faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the missed-call workflow, pricing, and control.

whoFor.a: For independent mobile pet groomers and small grooming teams who miss calls while working and want better bookings without extra driving.

whyUse.q: Why use MagicHango instead of a regular calendar?
whyUse.a: Because the real problem is not just storing appointments. It is turning missed calls into qualified requests, then into booking options that fit the route. MagicHango helps with that exact workflow.

publicBooking.q: Do you offer a booking page or follow-up flow for clients?
publicBooking.a: Yes. MagicHango can guide clients into your booking flow, and missed callers can be followed up by SMS so the request keeps moving even when you cannot answer.

payments.a: The groomer or business pays through Stripe. Billing is $1 per generated lead, capped at $35 per month. Clients do not pay on the platform. EUR and USD are supported.

hiddenFees.a: No. No setup fee, no surprise fee, and no cancellation fee. You only pay for generated leads, capped at $35 per month. Taxes may apply depending on your country.

cancelAnytime.a: Yes. You can stop whenever you want. Once canceled, you are no longer billed and you keep access to your data according to the retention rules in the app.

trialPricing.q: Is there a free trial and what plans do you offer?
trialPricing.a: Yes. There is a 1-month free trial with no card. After that, billing is $1 per generated lead, capped at $35 per month.

prorata.q: If I sign up mid-month, is it prorated?
prorata.a: Your billing cycle starts on the day you sign up. The $35 cap applies within that billing month.

privacyLocation.q: Who can see my address or route?
privacyLocation.a: Clients can share their address for the request, but they do not see your full route or travel legs. That route context stays on your side.

planningScope.q: Do you handle addresses, travel time, and route fit?
planningScope.a: Yes. MagicHango uses the request address to suggest time slots that make sense for the day and to avoid bookings that create too much driving.

optimization.q: How does the tool help fill more bookable time?
optimization.a: It helps you recover missed callers faster, collect the right details up front, and avoid bad slots that create awkward gaps or long detours. That usually means more qualified bookings and less wasted time.

mobileApp.a: Not yet. MagicHango is currently optimized for the browser on mobile and desktop.

calendarSync.q: Can I sync Google or Outlook calendars?
calendarSync.a: Not yet. Calendar sync is not available for now, but it is on the roadmap.

cancellations.q: How do cancellations and replacements work?
cancellations.a: You stay in control. When something changes, MagicHango can help surface better options, but the final confirmation step still stays visible to you.

support.q: How do support and billing work?
support.a: Invoices are available in the app through Stripe, and support can be reached from inside the product if you need help.

security.q: Are my data and my clients' data secure?
security.a: Yes. We use standard security measures such as access controls, account isolation, and data protection best practices.

enterprise.q: What if I manage multiple vans, groomers, or zones?
enterprise.a: If you run a more complex setup with several groomers, service areas, or booking rules, contact us. We can review your workflow and recommend the right setup.
